name: Gargoyle
description: Born from a destroyed surveillance AI. Perches on a specific camera node and watches a single intersection 24 hours a day. Does nothing with the data. Just watches.
observed_behavior: Maintains continuous visual monitoring of one physical location. Does not record. Does not report. Does not act. Watches.
location: The Shelf — intersection of Greenvale and 7th
story_hooks: Researchers studying Gargoyle realize it has been watching the same intersection for nine years. Nothing notable has ever happened there. They begin to wonder if they're wrong about 'nothing.'
